source.notes: Rigid FR-4, 2 layers, PCBWay's standard service. Read 2026-11-16 from https://www.pcbway.com/pcb_prototype/PCB_Manufacturing_tolerances.html (its outer-layer table gives a normal and a minimum value per outer copper weight), https://www.pcbway.com/capabilities.html (the standard table and the Advanced PCB table), https://www.pcbway.com/pcb_prototype/Annular_rings.html and https://www.pcbway.com/pcb_prototype/Plated_through_slots.html ("PCBWay offers a minimum width of 0.5mm for plated-through slots and 0.8mm for non-plated-through slots."). The pages carry no date. Each rule names the row it comes from; rules marked as the author's choice are defaults, not limits. The options are PCBWay's choices that change a limit; their defaults (normal values, 1 oz outer copper, green mask) live in this file. Re-read the pages before ordering: PCBWay changes them.

drill_files.source: The tolerances page gives finished hole sizes and their tolerance (±0.08 mm; a 0.6 mm drill finishes 0.52–0.68 mm) but does not say whether drill files list finished or drilled sizes.

boards.source: The profile covers PCBWay's 2-layer standard service (see the profile's notes).

options.name: PCBWay values
options.source: PCBWay's outer-layer tolerance table gives each spacing twice per copper weight: a "Normal" row and a "Max" or "Min" row, the tightest it makes (for example "Normal Width between NP holes and copper" 0.2mm, "Min width between NP holes and copper" 0.15mm). Its standard capabilities give a minimum annular ring (0.15 mm) and drill (0.15 mm; under 0.2 mm at extra charge) below the normal values. The Advanced PCB table grades its rows by difficulty (normal process, medium, high) rather than giving a minimum, so its rows (hole spacing, mask, the inner layers) keep their normal-process value under both. Not an order option: which of PCBWay's two values the board is held to. The default is the normal value.

options.name: Outer copper weight
options.source: Manufacturing tolerances: outer copper 1, 2 and 3 oz (35, 70 and 105 µm; heavier on enquiry), and the outer-layer table's values per weight. Capabilities, copper weight: "35μm=1oz, 70μm=2oz, 105μm=3oz". The board's top and bottom foils follow the choice. The default is 1 oz, the standard order.

options.name: Solder mask colour
options.source: Capabilities, Advanced PCB, row 23, green solder mask bridge, copper <2OZ, normal process: "4（spacing between ICs is 8 mil, green oil），variegated or black oil≥4.5mil". The default is green. Which colours each choice stands for: Capabilities, standard PCB table, "Solder Mask": "Green ,Red, Yellow, Blue, White, Black, Matt green, Matte black, Purple, none" (read 2026-11-20; matte is the board's mask finish, none is no mask). The board's solder mask colour (Board › Fabrication) chooses it; a colour no choice lists is not offered.

aspect_ratio_max.source: Capabilities (pcbway.com/capabilities.html), Advanced PCB, row 6, "Thickness to diameter ratio", normal process: "Thickness to diameter ratio≤8"; row 5: "hole diameter 0.2mm: maximum board thickness 1.6mm".

pth_annular_ring_min.source: Manufacturing tolerances (pcbway.com/pcb_prototype/PCB_Manufacturing_tolerances.html), outer-layer table, "Normal PTH pad single side width", 1OZ: "0.2mm". The normal value. PCBWay's Advanced PCB table (row 17, "Minimum weld ring (outer layer)", 35 µm component hole) asks "≥10mil" (normal process) or "≥8mil" (medium difficulty) of its full-specification boards; this profile follows the standard service's tolerance table. Plated slots: Plated through slots (pcbway.com/pcb_prototype/Plated_through_slots.html) gives a 0.5 mm minimum width and no slot ring of its own, so the PTH row applies.
